draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.46, the 21st-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 4th of 34 at WR. He went 22nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Greg Jennings. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2019) ranked 1st in receiving yards among the 34 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Minnesota Vikings. 94 career games and 91 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 10 AV in 2025 against a career-best 15 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: team target share 30.1% (99th percentile), approximate value 10 (92nd percentile), receiving yards 1,048 (90th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 wide receiver who played: 1,048 receiving yards against a median of 502, above the norm.
